meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为作品添加品牌色彩与排版风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为内容快速应用品牌视觉规范。
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand colors and typography to your artifacts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand visual guidelines to your content.

howto.what: Claude 会把 Anthropic 官方品牌配色与字体应用到文档、幻灯片等产物上:标题用 Poppins、正文用 Lora(缺失时回退 Arial/Georgia),非文字形状轮换橙、蓝、绿强调色。
howto.when: 当作品需要套用品牌配色、视觉排版或公司设计标准时,该技能接管,负责按 Anthropic 视觉规范调整。

say.text: 把这份幻灯片的标题改成 Poppins、正文改成 Lora
say.note: 套用品牌字体,缺失时回退 Arial/Georgia

say.text: 给这份文档套上 Anthropic 的品牌配色
say.note: 使用官方色值,非文字形状用强调色

say.text: 检查我的这份设计是否符合公司品牌规范
say.note: 按官方配色与字体核对

howto.what_en: Claude applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to documents, slides, and other artifacts: Poppins for headings, Lora for body text (falling back to Arial/Georgia), and orange, blue, green accents for shapes.
howto.when_en: Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply to the artifact.

say_en.text: Set this slide deck's headings to Poppins and body text to Lora
say_en.note: Applies brand fonts, falling back to Arial/Georgia

say_en.text: Apply Anthropic brand colors to this document
say_en.note: Uses official color values and accent shapes

say_en.text: Check whether my design follows the company brand guidelines
say_en.note: Compares colors and typography to the guidelines
